Short description: The Columbia PowerFill 3.5 Pro Series Cordless Loading Pump is a high-speed, battery-powered system that automates the filling of automatic taping and finishing tools, eliminating manual pumping fatigue.
Description:
The Columbia PowerFill 3.5 Pro Series Cordless Loading Pump is a battery-powered compound delivery system designed to streamline the filling of automatic taping and finishing tools. By replacing manual pumping with a single-button, motorized mechanism, this unit helps reduce operator fatigue during high-volume joint compound transfer tasks. It features a flow rate of up to 3.5 gpm and is capable of pumping up to 55 gallons on a single charge of its compatible 20V MAX DEWALT lithium-ion battery.

The unit includes a Hi-Rise fill tube that allows for upright operation and can be rotated to position the outlet over buckets, helping to contain drips and save space. The pump is built with a PowerStroke design and features a convertible outlet that can be adjusted for right or left-sided discharge.

Maintenance is simplified through tool-less access to the pump cylinder, inlet, and filter. The ProConnect system allows for the quick removal of the powerhead and pump for storage and cleaning. The unit includes an adjustable bucket stabilizer with an oversized foot bracket to secure the pump to most 5-gallon containers.
